info.title: Lightweight Portal CMS API
info.description: Generated from the router by `php bin/openapi.php`. Do not edit by hand: a contract test fails when this document and the routes disagree. It describes the core API; a route contributed by a plugin is not included, because whether it exists depends on whether that plugin is active.

session.name: PHPSESSID
session.description: The session created by POST /auth/login. This API has no bearer tokens: it authenticates with the same session cookie the admin uses.

data.description: The resource, or a list of resources.

meta.description: Always an object, never an array, so a client can read it without a shape check.

code.description: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, stable enough to branch on.

details.description: Present only when there is something to say, such as field errors.
